subject: automatically switching tabs when a gvisTable row is selected

messages.author: 736d649b49eba837
messages.subject: automatically switching tabs when a gvisTable row is selected
parts:
Hi, following the instructions in another topic, i have the code below in server.R that displays a gvisTable in Tab1 and when a row is selected (clicked on) it updates the value in a textInput box. Then, when i switch to Tab2 the value in the textInput box is read and a graph is displayed based on that value. The code works fine.

Instead of manually switching tabs (from Tab1 to Tab2) to see the graph based on the row selected in the table, i would like automatically switch tabs when the row in is selected (clicked on).

Does anyone know how this may be accomplished?

thanks

output$foo <- renderGvis({
   
    jscode <- "
    var sel = chart.getSelection();
    var row = sel[0].row;
    var text = data.getValue(row,1);
    $('input#selected').val(row);
    $('input#selected').change();
    "
    
    b=my_data_table
    
    pl <- gvisTable(b,options=list(height=600,width=1000,gvis.listener.jscode=jscode))
    return(pl)
  })
